cmos.coordinate_origin: full-frame center between the two middle pixels

reported_crop.purpose: same central crop used by the fixed C3.3 ROI interface

frozen_phase_adaptation_trigger.use: decide whether to run the preauthorized C3.4 geometry-adapted phase training; never select the final phase

printed material and refractive indices at 532 nm
printer lateral/axial PSF, minimum feature, shrinkage and edge error
